text: On the 13th of April, the Chiefs of Staff approved the plan. Two days later, Colonel John Bevan of the London Controlling Section briefed Winston Churchill. According to Bevan, he found the Prime Minister in bed, smoking a cigar. When Bevan warned that the Spanish might simply hand the body back with the papers unread, Churchill replied that, in that case, they would have to get the body back and give it another swim.
